meta.title: During submission time, bids are on Sum Total and auto-broken down pro rata
gaps: Verify that every bid is broken down on a pro-rata basis with item values mathematically derived from the vendor's Sum Total.
Assert that all vendor submissions, rather than merely the visible response view, are marked as Auto-breakdown.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that every bid is broken down on a pro-rata basis with item values mathematically derived from the vendor's Sum Total.; Assert that all vendor submissions, rather than merely the visible response view, are marked as Auto-breakdown.

steps.note: Open an existing live auction with bids, as required to inspect responses during submission time.
Navigate to the buyer's auction Responses view.
Assert that at least one vendor response is present in the auction response grid.
Verify that the response view exposes the vendor's total amount.
Verify that the UI identifies the submission as an automatically broken-down bid.
